title: Concept: CSRF protection disabled (python) — review required
description: In python, csrf_exempt removes the unguessable-token check browsers cannot forge. Exempted endpoints trust ambient credentials alone. The remedy is restoring @csrf_protect.
applicability: python web handlers and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-site request forgery on state-changing endpoints; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for account and payment actions.
